goal: Build the reusable implementation foundation beneath arbitrary bounded program realizations. A/B remains the recursive mathematical operation; this software foundation must preserve enough referent/boundary/input/representation/operation/state/output/witness structure that new programs stop requiring the same scaffolding to be rebuilt by hand.
next_movement: Lift pairwise contract-checked composition into a generic bounded execution graph: nodes are program realizations, edges are declared value relations, graph validation rejects unresolved inputs/incompatible contracts/cycles that lack an explicit state-time model, and execution preserves lineage through the graph. Do not add domain behavior to the kernel.
walls: Do not redefine A/B as the software foundation, workflow, factory, or runtime.
Do not let resume ability categories select development.
Do not add a program shape merely to increase category coverage.
Kernel logic must remain domain/category agnostic.
A realization-specific concern belongs outside the kernel unless multiple unrelated realizations force the same relation.

handoff.reason: Explicit user-directed resume of the Multi-Source State & Reconciliation / resume-evidence build in this window. ARC remains pinned/resumable in TASKS.md.
